name: Aether Quant
notes: Populate projectId and organizationId after the Lean cloud project exists.
This file stores local project metadata and does not replace lean.json.

phase1.objective: Define a compact V1 universe with shared Lean data coverage for training and backtesting.

features.normalization: Fit the scaler on the training window only and apply the same transformation to validation, backtest and live inference.

target.label_rule: 1 if next close return is positive, otherwise 0

phase9.objective: Expand the universe while keeping thin-history assets visible but safely observation-only.

ib.notes: Credentials (ib-account/ib-user-name/ib-password/ib-trading-mode) live in lean.json - Lean's own live/paper InteractiveBrokersBrokerage config, untouched by this flag. This block only controls: (1) whether aq fetch futures/options and data_pipeline/ib_backfill.py are allowed to run at all ('enabled'), and (2) the local TWS/IB Gateway socket API connection settings (host/port/client_id) used for offline historical-data backfill, a second independent API client alongside whatever Lean's own brokerage uses when live-deployed. See 'aq ib status'.
